achievements.riddle: The sun rose and set and still you fought.
They never got to see their fourth land.
Nobody won, and nobody lost.
White, blue, black, red and green walked into a bar.
They fell, and you never raised a hand.
Not one point more than needed.
You only ever needed one.
Twice as alive as anyone at the table.
Their hands were empty. Yours were not.
Three turns. That's all it took.
Thirteen turns, and luck had nothing to do with it.
Ten fell before you.
Ten cards in hand, and still hungry.
A dozen lands to call your own.
Outnumbered two to one, and still standing.
Every soldier came home.
One pack in a thousand is blessed.

achievements.riddle: The sun rose and set and still you fought.
They never got to see their fourth land.
Nobody won, and nobody lost.
White, blue, black, red and green walked into a bar.
They fell, and you never raised a hand.
Not one point more than needed.
You only ever needed one.
Twice as alive as anyone at the table.
Their hands were empty. Yours were not.
Three turns. That's all it took.
Thirteen turns, and luck had nothing to do with it.
Ten fell before you.
Ten cards in hand, and still hungry.
A dozen lands to call your own.
Outnumbered two to one, and still standing.
Every soldier came home.
One pack in a thousand is blessed.

achievements.riddle: The sun rose and set and still you fought.
They never got to see their fourth land.
Nobody won, and nobody lost.
White, blue, black, red and green walked into a bar.
They fell, and you never raised a hand.
Not one point more than needed.
You only ever needed one.
Twice as alive as anyone at the table.
Their hands were empty. Yours were not.
Three turns. That's all it took.
Thirteen turns, and luck had nothing to do with it.
Ten fell before you.
Ten cards in hand, and still hungry.
A dozen lands to call your own.
Outnumbered two to one, and still standing.
Every soldier came home.
One pack in a thousand is blessed.

achievements.riddle: The sun rose and set and still you fought.
They never got to see their fourth land.
Nobody won, and nobody lost.
White, blue, black, red and green walked into a bar.
They fell, and you never raised a hand.
Not one point more than needed.
You only ever needed one.
Twice as alive as anyone at the table.
Their hands were empty. Yours were not.
Three turns. That's all it took.
Thirteen turns, and luck had nothing to do with it.
Ten fell before you.
Ten cards in hand, and still hungry.
A dozen lands to call your own.
Outnumbered two to one, and still standing.
Every soldier came home.
One pack in a thousand is blessed.
